title: Pied Piper
label: Ruff Sqwad Recordings (unconfirmed)
format: White label vinyl (unverified for this title)
producers: Rapid and/or Dirty Danger (not individually credited in sources opened)

type.basis: Release details provisional: made around 2002 according to its producer, but the release date and label are unconfirmed.

sound.text: Early Ruff Sqwad tracks such as 'Pied Piper' were dark but melodic, with squelchy, teenage-sounding noises.
sound.pub: undated (Guardian, Dan Hancox, via inkl; date not shown)

sound.text: A 'spartan' beat that feels slightly unnatural without an MC on it.
Rapid and Dirty Danger started out on FruityLoops 3; Rapid says he was about 14 or 15 when Pied Piper was made.

context.text: Rapid dates it around 2002, the earliest track on White Label Classics.
Ruff Sqwad: crew formed 2001 in Bow, East London; played on Rinse FM, Heat, Flava, Mystic and Deja Vu FM; singles self-released on white label as Ruff Sqwad Recordings.
